    STATE TB_SC_TIME 3
    STATE TB_DONT_CARE 65535
  APPEND_ITEM FPRIME_TIME_CONTEXT 8 UINT "F Prime time context"
  APPEND_ITEM FPRIME_TIME_SECONDS 32 UINT "F Prime time seconds"
  APPEND_ITEM FPRIME_TIME_USECONDS 32 UINT "F Prime time microseconds"
  ITEM FPRIME_TIME 0 0 DERIVED "F Prime time as Unix time (valid for TB_WORKSTATION_TIME)"
    READ_CONVERSION openc3/conversions/unix_time_conversion.py FPRIME_TIME_SECONDS FPRIME_TIME_USECONDS

TELEMETRY <%= target_name %> FPRIME_UNKNOWN BIG_ENDIAN "F Prime packets not handled by this plugin (events, files, data products)"
  CATCHALL
  APPEND_ITEM FPRIME_DESCRIPTOR 16 UINT "F Prime packet descriptor"
    META FPRIME_TYPE "FwPacketDescriptorType"
    STATE FW_PACKET_COMMAND 0
    STATE FW_PACKET_TELEM 1
    STATE FW_PACKET_LOG 2
    STATE FW_PACKET_FILE 3
    STATE FW_PACKET_PACKETIZED_TLM 4
    STATE FW_PACKET_DP 5
    STATE FW_PACKET_IDLE 6
    STATE FW_PACKET_HAND 254
    STATE FW_PACKET_UNKNOWN 255
    STATE SPP_IDLE_PACKET 2047
    STATE INVALID_UNINITIALIZED 2048
  APPEND_ITEM DATA 0 BLOCK "Remaining packet bytes"
